purpose: Declare evidence availability semantics so PymIA does not confuse real zero, missing evidence, partial evidence, capped extraction, ambiguity, or excluded values.

MEASURED.meaning: The value was observed and normalized with sufficient confidence.
MEASURED.default_owner_message: Dato medido con la evidencia disponible.

ZERO_REAL.meaning: The value was observed and its value is genuinely zero.
ZERO_REAL.default_owner_message: El valor observado es cero real para esta fuente.

NOT_AVAILABLE.meaning: The value is not available in the provided evidence or could not be obtained.
NOT_AVAILABLE.default_owner_message: No se pudo determinar este dato con la evidencia actual.

PARTIAL.meaning: The value was derived from incomplete evidence.
PARTIAL.default_owner_message: Este dato surge de evidencia parcial.

CAPPED.meaning: The value was derived from evidence truncated by an explicit extraction or coverage cap.
CAPPED.default_owner_message: Este dato puede estar limitado por cobertura o truncamiento de extracción.

AMBIGUOUS.meaning: The value is present but cannot be trusted because format, meaning, or parsing is ambiguous.
AMBIGUOUS.default_owner_message: Este dato es ambiguo y no se usó para calcular.

EXCLUDED.meaning: The value was intentionally excluded from calculation due to an explicit rule or quality problem.
EXCLUDED.default_owner_message: Este dato fue excluido del cálculo por una regla de calidad de evidencia.

zero_semantics.ZERO_REAL: A measured zero is valid evidence.
zero_semantics.NOT_AVAILABLE: Unavailable evidence must never be coerced to zero.
